items.selectedPrompt: Precise-object-edit: correct this two-panel lat pulldown educational illustration. Output 2:1 wide canvas, two equal square panels, white background, no text. items.selectedPrompt: Precise correction of attached machine chest press two-panel guide. Preserve entire left panel, both figures, fixed machine frame, base, low hinges, white background, black shorts, anatomy and muscle colors. Output same 2:1 canvas, TWO EQUAL SQUARE PANELS, no text. Fix RIGHT PANEL mechanically: weight plates should be exactly FOUR TOTAL like the left: TWO upper plates lifted and TWO bottom plates still at the base. Currently right has THREE upper plates: remove ONE upper plate by replacing that block with exactly TWO plates matching left plate thickness, not by changing bottom plates. Critical lever geometry: keep BOTH low floor hinges at exactly same relative square coordinates as left image. Each long gray lever must have EXACT same length as left.
